title: Liam Neeson plants a kiss on Pamela Anderson in new Naked Gun promo - NewsBreak
text: Liam Neeson planted a kiss on Pamela Anderson during a new promo for their comedy film The Naked Gun . Paramount took to Instagram with a video showing the 73-year-old actor and his co-star enjoying popcorn as they seemed to be watching their new movie in an empty theater. After throwing popcorn at each other, Pamela had nestled her head into Liam’s shoulder, giving him the opportunity to kiss the top of her head before a graphic covered up their intimate moment. Adding to the mill of romance rumors , the production company captioned the video, “A couple that laughs together, stays together.” READ MORE: Fox News Greg Gutfeld 'confirms' swirling rumors on his co-star Jesse Watters READ MORE: Ed Sheeran leaves busker stunned with kind gesture after he sings cover version The 73-year-old actor leads the new remake of the hit 1988 film The Naked Gun. The new comedy, which released on Aug. 1, acts as a sequel to the 1988 film, which followed Frank Dreblin, a clueless police detective who sets out to find the culprit of his partner’s murder. In the new movie, Liam will take the place of Frank’s son. Following in his father’s footsteps, he must solve a murder case to prevent the police department from shutting down. The promo comes days after a source seemingly confirmed to People the two are dating. "It's a budding romance in the early stages. It's sincere, and it's clear they're smitten with each other,” the insider revealed. Pamela and Liam are “enjoying each other’s company.” Reports have suggested they are both currently at Pamela's home in Canada . A source shared to Daily Mail , “She has been telling friends he is smitten and does a lot of sweet things for her, like sending her flowers, and spending time with her sons and dogs. "Pam cooks and gardens at home... It's wholesome and appealing and very un-Hollywood, and Liam loves that. He actually gets involved." Pamela previously revealed she used her home cooking to win Liam over. During a SiriusXM Town Hall event in New York City on Wednesday, Pamela revealed, "[I was] nervous to meet [Liam], of course and you're always nervous the first day on the set. "I brought sourdough bread to Liam, cookies, and muffins, and kept myself busy. Kept me outta trouble ... It's a very special [muffin] recipe. It's very good for you. Let's just say that." Neeson later confirmed, “Pamela's sourdough was phenomenal,” while also sharing how he remembers meeting the actress for the first time. “Well, you know, we had never met before and I remember thinking: ‘Wow, she is gorgeous,’” he said. “But she had this wonderful sense of silliness and just humanity about her.” “I don’t want to blow her head up, but it was like I just felt an ease with her… and we discovered a silliness with each other, which was terrific, you know?”
